title: 2020 年 9 月英语六级真题（第 3 套）

units.task: 围绕名言"Wealth of the mind is the only true wealth"写一篇议论文，阐释精神财富才是真正财富的含义，至少150词，不超过200词。
outline: 引出名言，点明主旨：精神财富（知识、智慧、品格）才是真正的财富，引发读者思考。
分层论证：①物质财富具有易逝性与脆弱性，精神财富不可剥夺；②精神富足才能带来持久幸福与人生意义，可辅以名人事例。
总结全文，发出号召：在追求物质的同时更应注重精神世界的充实，呼应首段名言。
units.sample:
The celebrated saying "Wealth of the mind is the only true wealth" serves as a profound reminder that intellectual and spiritual richness far outweighs material possessions. In an era increasingly obsessed with financial success, this timeless wisdom deserves our careful reflection.

To begin with, material wealth is inherently fragile and temporary. Fortunes can evaporate overnight due to economic downturns, natural disasters, or poor decisions. Mental wealth, by contrast, encompasses knowledge, wisdom, critical thinking, and emotional resilience — assets that no external force can strip away. A well-cultivated mind empowers individuals to adapt, innovate, and thrive regardless of circumstances. Furthermore, genuine happiness and fulfillment stem not from the accumulation of possessions but from intellectual curiosity, meaningful relationships, and a sense of purpose. History abounds with examples of wealthy individuals who felt spiritually empty, while scholars and thinkers living modestly led deeply satisfying lives. Socrates, for instance, possessed almost nothing materially yet remains one of the most revered figures in human history.

In conclusion, while material comfort is undeniably important, it is the wealth of the mind that truly defines a rich and meaningful life. We should therefore devote more effort to nurturing our intellect and spirit.

phrases.cn: 远远超过；用于比较两事物的重要性，比 be more important than 更正式
本质上脆弱且短暂的；inherently 表示'内在地'，增强论证力度

phrases.en: no external force can strip away
phrases.cn: 任何外力都无法剥夺；strip away 意为'剥去、夺走'，用于强调精神财富的持久性
源于、起因于；可替换 come from / result from，更为学术
充满了例子；abound with 为高分搭配，表'富于、充满'
使命感、目标感；常用于论述人生意义的语境
经过良好培养的头脑；cultivated 既指'培养的'也暗含'有教养的'
投入更多努力于……；devote ... to 后接名词或动名词，属经典高分结构
永恒的智慧；timeless 意为'不受时间限制的'，常修饰 wisdom, truth, value 等

pitfalls: 审题偏差：将 wealth of the mind 仅理解为'知识'，忽视品格、情感、精神层面的丰富内涵
通篇空谈道理而缺乏具体事例或对比论证，论点显得单薄
首尾段几乎一模一样地重复名言，缺少升华和深化，结尾流于形式
词汇单一：全文反复使用 important / money / rich，未做同义替换或升级
逻辑衔接缺失：段落之间缺少 furthermore / by contrast / in conclusion 等过渡词，文章松散

upgrades.plain: Material wealth is not as important as mental wealth.
upgrades.better: Material wealth pales in comparison with the enduring richness of a cultivated mind.
upgrades.note: pale in comparison with 表达更生动，enduring richness 比 mental wealth 更具画面感

upgrades.plain: Many rich people are not happy.
upgrades.better: History abounds with examples of affluent individuals who, despite their vast fortunes, felt spiritually hollow.
upgrades.note: abound with + 定语从句 + despite 让步结构，信息密度和句式层次显著提升

upgrades.plain: We should read more books to improve ourselves.
upgrades.better: We should devote more effort to nurturing our intellect through lifelong learning and critical reflection.
upgrades.note: devote effort to + nurturing + through 结构更正式，lifelong learning 体现学术视野

upgrades.plain: This saying tells us that mind is more important than money.
upgrades.better: This celebrated aphorism reminds us that intellectual and spiritual enrichment constitutes the truest form of wealth.
upgrades.note: aphorism 替换 saying，constitute 替换 is，enrichment 替换 mind，用词更高级

upgrades.plain: In a word, we should pay attention to the wealth of the mind.
upgrades.better: In conclusion, while material comfort is undeniably important, it is the wealth of the mind that truly defines a rich and meaningful life.
upgrades.note: while 让步 + 强调句型 it is ... that 让结尾更有层次感和说服力

band9: The celebrated saying serves as a profound reminder that intellectual and spiritual richness far outweighs material possessions. 这句用 serve as a reminder + far outweigh 引出主题，结构正式且有力。
Mental wealth encompasses knowledge, wisdom, critical thinking, and emotional resilience — assets that no external force can strip away. 破折号后用同位语补充说明，信息密度高，适合论证段使用。
Genuine happiness and fulfillment stem not from the accumulation of possessions but from intellectual curiosity, meaningful relationships, and a sense of purpose. not ... but ... 并列结构对比鲜明，三项并列增强节奏感。
History abounds with examples of wealthy individuals who felt spiritually empty, while scholars living modestly led deeply satisfying lives. abound with + while 对比句，举例与对比一气呵成，论证效率极高。
It is the wealth of the mind that truly defines a rich and meaningful life. 强调句型收束全文，呼应主题，语气坚定有力，适合作为结尾金句背诵。
